verses.text: For the music director. To be played on stringed instruments. A psalm. A song. May God be kind to us and bless us. May his face shine on us. Selah.
Then your ways will be known on earth, and your saving power among all nations.
Let the nations praise you, God. Let all the nations praise you.
Let the nations be glad and sing for joy, because you judge the peoples fairly and guide the nations on earth. Selah.
Let the nations praise you, God. Let all the nations praise you.
The land has given its harvest. God, our God, blesses us.
God blesses us. All the ends of the earth will respect him.
